key_insight: A new quantum algorithm improves the stated TSP time bound from O*(1.7274^n) to O*(1.70961^n) by combining extremal set systems with quantum search.
engineering_relevance: The result reduces theoretical exponential scaling for exact route optimization and offers improved quantum time–space tradeoffs, but does not establish practical hardware performance.
method: Split the optimal tour into four consecutive subpaths of unequal sizes.
Use extremal set systems and dynamic programming to compute optimal subpath values with low success probability.
Apply amplitude amplification within the existing quantum TSP framework.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical runtime bounds and improved time–space tradeoffs, with no empirical benchmarks or hardware evaluation.
watch_item: Runtime remains exponential, and the abstract does not quantify implementation overhead or hardware resource requirements.
paper_title: Improved Quantum Algorithms for TSP and More
